description: Linux platform guide for the agent-desktop CLI. Lists per command group what works on X11 and on Wayland, how to check the AT-SPI accessibility bus, the first-contact gotchas (app names, Chromium and Electron flags, headed focus, blocked key combos), and where to find lifecycle, screenshot, clipboard, tray, notification and troubleshooting details. Triggers on: "linux desktop automation", "AT-SPI tree", "automate GNOME app", "agent-desktop on Linux", "accessibility bus not available", "empty supported_surfaces", "wayland screenshot consent", or any Linux GUI interaction task.
